comment: Floating eye (BNpcBase 182). Retail's (Bob's Chronofoil captures 412ba91d, b166797f and 7d85c539 of 2026-11-01 and the Recorder's v154, Power of Deduction's eye, layout 4299601, level 29: four fights): 513 once as it opened, then 970 every 3.06 s instead of an auto-attack. 970 hit level 32-33 players for 30-68 (median 48 at level 33); the default damage is kept, since open-world eyes of other levels share this timeline.
